potential_false_negatives.note: recorded as cut on the first screen, but the blind scorer puts them at or above the advance bar. VMD, home respiratory care growing about 25 percent a year, is the screen's clearest candidate miss in this sample.

reverse_disagreements.note: recorded at or above the bar, blind scorer well below. IRS at recorded 42 contradicts the engine's own industry table, which prices real-estate rent extraction at need 8; the anomaly looks like an error in the recorded score, not in the blind one.

estimated_fn_rate.basis: 1 of the 8 sampled hard cuts (stages 0 and 2); a 12-name sample bounds this loosely, and widening the sample is the standing way to tighten it
